To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
NUREG-based approach is a good tool to assess diversity of I&C system, but it is not enough to make the choice of technical solutions at the early stages.
NUREG70007-based approach is a good starting point for diversity analysis of multi-version I&C systems, but it is not enough for the final assessment of system reliability.

the use of reliability models and diversity metrics for multi-version I&C systems assessment can be an effective tool for NPP I&C designers and engineers to make informed and confident decisions at early stages of I&C system development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology for the analysis of the diversity of multi-version I&C systems.

the following issues: • Analysis of NUREG7003 and NUREG7006 guidelines, as well as the CLB-based diversity assessment methods; • Development of the methodology for multi-version NUREG and CLB-based NPP I&C assessment; • Creation of a software tool for NUREG7000-based diversity assessment of I&C systems; • Creation of software tools for diversity assessment and optimization of multi-version NUREGs and CLBs-based I&C systems.
the development of the diversity assessment techniques for I&C systems of nuclear power plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NUREG-based and CLB-based approaches are complementary to each other and should be used in parallel to assess I&C systems.

the NUREG-based technique for diversity assessment is a well-known and well-developed approach, but there is no universal technique and tool for multi-version I&C systems assessment and it is a subject for further research.
NUREG70007-based method is the only existing approach to diversity assessment of multi-version I&C systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NUREG70007-based techniques for NPP I&C diversity assessment are the most appropriate for the use, but they can be improved with the use of reliability models and indexes.
NUREG7000 series and other approaches to diversity assessment are useful and effective in the terms of CCF risk reduction.

the NUREG-based techniques for diversity and redundancy assessment of NPP I& C systems can be enhanced by using the CLB-based reliability models, diversity indexes and reliability indexes of I&C system components.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of diversity metrics for NPP I&C reliability estimation is a promising way to improve the efficiency of D3 assessment.
diversity assessment of NPP I+C systems is an important part of the design process, which can help in the selection of appropriate diversity strategies.
diversity assessment techniques should be based on reliability models and metrics, which are more informative and sensitive to system design and implementation features.
